page.notes: The index is set in three columns, which I read left, middle, right. Wrapped entries were joined into one line, so a page number that wrapped to the next printed line is kept on the same <l>. The running head is printed as "I N D E ·X·"; I have given it as INDEX and have not included the trailing X mark. The decorated initial F at the head of the lower right section is the start of "Fabulæ". A small printer's mark (diamond) sits at the bottom right and is not transcribed. No page number is printed on this page.
